blind.description: A low, rounded mound of overlapping golden coins with embedded treasure pieces: a small tilted gold goblet/chalice, a strand of white pearl beads, two faceted red gems, and a rounded green gem. The coins form a solid, continuous textured pile resting directly and flatly on the ground with no plinth. Materials are reflective metallic gold, pearlescent white, and glossy translucent colored gems.
blind.from_above: A circular textured mound of gold coins featuring a visible circular goblet rim, a curved string of pearls, and faceted red and green jewels embedded across its surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/5 as tall as the figure (roughly 1 to 1.5 feet high) and around 2 to 2.5 feet wide across the base.
